$comment: Hinglish dialogue. Har key ek mission id + beat hai. 'speaker' characters.json ka id hai. Engine ye lines subtitle bar mein chalata hai.

a1_m1:start.speaker: amma
a1_m1:start.text: Uth ja Vicky. Shutter khol, Sharma ji ki gaadi aaj deni hai.

a1_m1:start.speaker: amma
a1_m1:start.text: Chai baad mein. Aur Cart Road se jaana - Mall pe gaadi nahi.

a1_m1:end.speaker: vicky
a1_m1:end.text: Gaadi de aaya. Paise bhi mil gaye.

a1_m1:end.speaker: amma
a1_m1:end.text: Shabaash. Baap hota to khush hota.

a1_m2:start.speaker: nafisa
a1_m2:start.text: Tu ka ladka hai na? Andar aa.

a1_m2:start.speaker: nafisa
a1_m2:start.text: Tere baap ne mujhe ek list di thi. Ab wo nahi hai, aur list adhoori hai.

a1_m2:start.speaker: vicky
a1_m2:start.text: Meri baap ki list ka aapse kya lena-dena?

a1_m2:start.speaker: nafisa
a1_m2:start.text: Wahi to pata karna hai. Dhalli ke depot ki tasveer laa de.

a1_m3:start.speaker: guru
a1_m3:start.text: Vicky! Bali ke ladke tere peeche hain.

a1_m3:start.speaker: guru
a1_m3:start.text: Bhaag mat - chala. Cart Road pe jo pehle pahuncha, wahi jeeta.

a1_m4:start.speaker: chhotu
a1_m4:start.text: Bhaiya, 4:10 wali chhoti gaadi. Goods shed ke peeche wala dabba.

a1_m4:start.speaker: chhotu
a1_m4:start.text: Passenger to nahi hai. Itna mujhe pata hai.

a1_m5:start.speaker: chhotu
a1_m5:start.text: Jakhoo se poora Mall dikhta hai. Aur raat ko jo truck catchment se nikalta hai, wo bhi.

a1_m5:start.speaker: chhotu
a1_m5:start.text: Bandar mujhe pehchante hain. Aadmi nahi pehchante. Dono theek hai.

a1_m6:start.speaker: vicky
a1_m6:start.text: Amma, wo baap ki garage hai.

a2_m1:start.speaker: rana
a2_m1:start.text: Beta, teri garage ka bahut dukh hua. Baith.

a2_m1:start.speaker: rana
a2_m1:start.text: Shimla chhota sheher hai. Yahan sab pata chal jaata hai.

a2_m1:start.speaker: rana
a2_m1:start.text: Tu mere liye kaam kar. Nuksan bhi bhar dunga, aur sheher bhi dikha dunga.

a2_m2:start.speaker: bali
a2_m2:start.text: Secretariat mein ek file hai. Kal subah tak almari mein nahi honi chahiye.

a2_m2:start.speaker: bali
a2_m2:start.text: To tu pakda gaya. Devinder Sahab ka naam mat lena.

a2_m3:start.speaker: rana
a2_m3:start.text: Aaj Mall band hai. Meri gaadi Scandal Point pe khadi hai - le aa.

a2_m3:start.speaker: vicky
a2_m3:start.text: Mall pe gaadi le jaana jurm hai, Devinder Sahab.

a2_m3:start.speaker: rana
a2_m3:start.text: Haan. Isiliye tu ja raha hai, main nahi.

a2_m4:start.speaker: nafisa
a2_m4:start.text: Kal subah Annandale pe helicopter utrega. Usme koi minister nahi aa raha.

a2_m4:start.speaker: vicky
a2_m4:start.text: Aap ab bhi mujh pe bharosa karti hain?

a2_m4:start.speaker: nafisa
a2_m4:start.text: Nahi. Par tere paas ab Devinder ka pass hai. Wahi kaafi hai.

a2_m5:start.speaker: nafisa
a2_m5:start.text: Devinder ne asli register wahin rakha hai - kyunki wahan koi shak nahi karta.

a2_m6:start.speaker: guru
a2_m6:start.text: Register mein tere baap ka naam bhi hai, Vicky.

a2_m6:start.speaker: guru
a2_m6:start.text: Galat taraf. Ab tu decide kar - kaagaz jala dega, ya Bali se poochhega.

a2_m6:end.speaker: vicky
a2_m6:end.text: Usne kaha baap ne kabhi paisa nahi liya. Sirf gaadi theek ki thi. Har baar.

a2_m6:end.speaker: guru
a2_m6:end.text: Aur har baar wahi gaadi. Wahi rasta. Wahi raat.

a3_m1:start.speaker: chhotu
a3_m1:start.text: Jo latthe abhi nahi nikle, wo poore season andar rahenge. Aaj raat aakhri truck hai.

a3_m2:start.speaker: nafisa
a3_m2:start.text: Sab kuch ek jagah pahunchana hai. Aur ek hi raat hai.

a3_m2:start.speaker: nafisa
a3_m2:start.text: Sabse uncha point. Wahan se signal jaayega, aur wahan se sab dikhega.

a3_m2:end.speaker: nafisa
a3_m2:end.text: Chala gaya. Subah tak har akhbaar mein hoga.

a3_m2:end.speaker: nafisa
a3_m2:end.text: Devinder Shimla nahi hai, Vicky. Devinder sirf Shimla mein tha.

a3_m2:end.speaker: vicky
a3_m2:end.text: Amma ko bata dena main der se aaunga.

generic:mall_violation.speaker: vicky
generic:mall_violation.text: Mall pe gaadi... ab to pakka pakde jaayenge.

generic:snow.speaker: vicky
generic:snow.text: Barf pad rahi hai. Sambhal ke chalana padega.
